::: {#thm-unbiased-props}
#### Properties of unbiased estimators

If $\hth$ is an [unbiased](#def-unbiased) estimator of $\th$, then:

$$\E{\hth} = \th$$ {#eq-unbiased-exp}

$$\mselr{\hth} = \var{\hth}$$ {#eq-unbiased-mse}

:::

::: proof

For @eq-unbiased-exp, apply @thm-bias-exprs:

$$
\begin{aligned}
0 &= \bias{\hth}
&& \text{(definition of unbiased)}\\
&= \E{\hth} - \th
&& \text{(bias equals expectation minus truth)}
\end{aligned}
$$

Adding $\th$ to both sides gives $\E{\hth} = \th$.

For @eq-unbiased-mse, apply @thm-mse-bias-variance:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\mselr{\hth}
&= \sqf{\bias{\hth}} + \var{\hth}
&& \text{(MSE equals bias squared plus variance)}\\
&= 0^2 + \var{\hth}
&& \text{(definition of unbiased)}\\
&= \var{\hth}
&& \text{($0^2 = 0$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
